responseMessageContents.text:
This is the IVX project. The user is extremely frustrated because they are trying to attach AWS IAM policies to the `ivx-sns-production` user to enable S3 and CloudFront permissions for the landing page deploy. I have been going in circles. The user is in the AWS console at the "Add permissions" screen.

I need to be concise and clear. The user is asking "I am here what to do" with the screenshot showing the Add permissions page with a dropdown showing "Add permissions" and "Create inline policy". They are in the right place. They need to choose one of those.

Best path: "Create inline policy" lets them paste the exact JSON policy I gave. But they said "I set all fucking screen" earlier, suggesting they may have been trying to use "Add permissions" and attach managed policies. Either way, I need to give ONE clear instruction.

Given the screenshot shows the dropdown open, I should tell them to tap "Create inline policy" and then paste the policy. That's the most reliable path since they couldn't find the managed policies earlier.

I should be very concise, avoid asking questions, and give exact next steps.

You are on the right screen. Tap **"Create inline policy"**.

Then paste this exact JSON and name it **IVXPlatformDeployAccess**:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "IVXS3Landing",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "s3:PutObject",
        "s3:PutObjectAcl",
        "s3:GetObject",
        "s3:DeleteObject",
        "s3:ListBucket",
        "s3:HeadBucket"
      ],
      "Resource": [
        "arn:aws:s3:::ivxholding.com",
        "arn:aws:s3:::ivxholding.com/*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "Sid": "IVXCloudFront",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "cloudfront:CreateInvalidation",
        "cloudfront:GetInvalidation",
        "cloudfront:ListInvalidations"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:cloudfront::138045599684:distribution/E1C0DEI0VKCUYN"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "IVXSNS",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "sns:Publish",
        "sns:GetSMSAttributes",
        "sns:SetSMSAttributes"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

Save it. Then I will immediately deploy the landing page and run the full QA.
